itens.trecho: Intelectual e inteligente, é talvez o filme de animação mais adulto que a Pixar já lançou. Esta longa metragem de animação da Pixar é, sem dúvida, uma das mais originais e criativas que vi em muito tempo.

"Riley" is a pleasant little girl living with her parents in Minnesota where she plays ice hockey, has loads of friends and generally, all in her garden is rosey. Her parents decide they need to move to (a rather drab) house in San Francisco, though, and as you might expect this causes some new tensions, especially as their furniture seems to have been lost…

A powerfully moving story, Inside Out takes place inside the mind of a young girl, Riley, as she tackles relatively normal hassles, from growing up to moving away. Inside her mind comes five emotions, all with different perceptions of life.
